name: Mia
source:
Mia is Larfa’s childhood friend and rival. She is a sexy, furry cat-girl with cat-ears and a tail that move in reflection of her emotions. She wants to obtain everything Larfa owns, but doesn’t show any tenderness. She is the type who will do whatever it takes to achieve her goals. She tempts Yuusaku at every opportunity. 

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=34#characters]mangagamer.com[/url]]
